description: Test helper functions and setup code for email package in Mattermost, including test environment setup, mock configurations, and utility methods for creating users, teams, channels, and configuring test settings.

classes.name: TestHelper
classes.description: Helper struct for setting up and managing test environment, including users, teams, channels, and configuration.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment, possibly with real or mock store, and returns a TestHelper instance.

methods.name: SetupWithStoreMock
methods.description: Sets up test environment with a mocked store and status store, returns a TestHelper instance.

methods.name: setupTestHelper
methods.description: Internal function to initialize TestHelper with given store and testing object.

methods.name: InitBasic
methods.description: Creates basic user, team, and channel setup for tests.

methods.name: CreateTeam
methods.description: Creates and saves a new team in the store.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Creates and saves a new channel within a team.

methods.name: addUserToChannel
methods.description: Adds a user to a channel as a member.

methods.name: addUserToTeam
methods.description: Adds a user to a team as a member.

methods.name: CreateUserOrGuest
methods.description: Creates a user or guest based on parameter.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Updates the configuration with a provided function.

methods.name: ConfigureInbucketMail
methods.description: Configures email settings for inbucket SMTP server in test environment.
